scale: 2x canvas px (288x288, feet 144,248); 1x = /2, 4x = x2; w facing: x' = 288 - x

points.head_top: top of the head (+1 cm): place HP bar / nameplate / overhead icons above this
points.chest: centre of mass in front of the chest: hitsplat + magic impact point on the player
points.tip: weapon tip per weapon layer for the anims that weapon is drawn in (melee contact, chop/mine impact, rod tip = fishing line)
